content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

Berlin's basketball team has just come out of a sobering season. Especially the home games have seen the team stay behind expectations. A sad highlight: Losing 60:87 to the weakish Mannheimers in a sold-out stadium. Indeed the team ended up third in the league, but given the cost of the star-players one could've expected more.
What is the relation between "but given the cost of the star-players one could've expected more." and "A sad highlight: Losing 60:87 to the weakish Mannheimers in a sold-out stadium." from the above essay? Choose from following options 1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
